warsaw.name: Warsaw
warsaw.description: The capital: rebuilt Old Town, world-class WWII and Jewish history museums, Chopin, and a big modern food scene. The main international airport.

stayAreas.name: Śródmieście (city centre)
stayAreas.description: Central, next to the main station and the Palace of Culture. Easy for trains; busy.

stayAreas.name: Powiśle
stayAreas.description: Leafy and trendy, near the river, cafés and the Copernicus Centre. Walkable to the Old Town.

stayAreas.name: Old Town / New Town
stayAreas.description: Postcard-pretty and right by the Christmas market, but touristy and further from the station.

gdansk.name: Gdańsk
gdansk.description: A Hanseatic port on the Baltic: colourful merchant houses, amber, Solidarity and WWII history, plus Sopot and Malbork Castle nearby.

stayAreas.name: Main Town (Główne Miasto)
stayAreas.description: The historic core around the Long Market and the river. Walk to almost everything.

stayAreas.name: Old Town (Stare Miasto)
stayAreas.description: Between the station and the shipyard; handy for trains and the Solidarity Centre.

stayAreas.name: Sopot
stayAreas.description: Seaside resort 20 min away by SKM train. Calm in winter; good for a slower stay.

krakow.name: Kraków
krakow.description: The medieval royal capital: Wawel, the Main Square, Kazimierz, and a base for Auschwitz, Wieliczka and Zakopane. Very vegan-friendly.

stayAreas.name: Old Town (Stare Miasto)
stayAreas.description: Inside the Planty ring, walk to everything and the Christmas market. Can be noisy at night.

stayAreas.name: Kazimierz
stayAreas.description: Historic Jewish quarter with the best cafés, bars and vegan food. 15 min walk to the Main Square.

stayAreas.name: Podgórze
stayAreas.description: Quieter, across the river from Kazimierz, near Schindler's Factory. Good value.

zakopane.name: Zakopane
zakopane.description: The mountain town in the Tatras: wooden highlander architecture, cable cars, thermal pools, and possibly early snow.

stayAreas.name: Centre (near Krupówki)
stayAreas.description: Walk to Krupówki Street, the Gubałówka funicular and the station. Lively.

stayAreas.name: Kościeliska Street area
stayAreas.description: Quieter, with traditional wooden villas and mountain views. 15 min walk to the centre.

prague.name: Prague
prague.description: Czech capital (not Poland: crowns, not złoty). Gothic and baroque old town, the castle, Charles Bridge, and some of Europe's best Christmas markets.

stayAreas.name: Old Town (Staré Město)
stayAreas.description: Steps from the Christmas markets and Charles Bridge. Busy and pricier.

stayAreas.name: Malá Strana
stayAreas.description: Romantic baroque quarter below the castle; quieter at night.

stayAreas.name: Vinohrady
stayAreas.description: Leafy, local and very dog-friendly (Riegrovy sady park), with great vegan cafés. 10 min walk to the main station.
